title: Workplace communication
description: Emails, customer support, safety instructions and business news.

texts.title: Office renovation schedule
texts.body:
TO: All Staff
FROM: Facilities Department
SUBJECT: Preparation for Office Renovations

The company will begin a major office [1] on June 2. The work is expected to take three weeks, during which several departments will temporarily move to the west wing.

To avoid interruptions, team leaders should [2] meeting rooms at least one day in advance. [3], employees are asked to remove personal items from desks in the affected area by May 29. [4]

Thank you for your cooperation. Please direct any questions to Facilities.

questions.explanation: The article “a” and the phrase “office ___” require a singular noun. “Renovation” names the planned work.
Meeting rooms are booked in advance, so “reserve” is the correct verb in this context.
The final instruction adds another requirement related to the renovation. “Additionally” introduces an extra point.

options: The building was originally opened in 1995.
All boxes should be clearly labeled with the employee's name and department.
The company also plans to review its annual marketing budget.
The west wing has the largest conference room.
questions.explanation: The inserted sentence gives a practical instruction connected to employees moving their belongings and working in another area.

texts.title: Replacement order confirmation
texts.body:
TO: Ms. Elena Morris
FROM: Customer Support
SUBJECT: Replacement for Order 58314

Thank you for informing us that your recent order contained a damaged item. We apologize for the [1] this has caused.

Our warehouse team has reviewed the photographs you provided and confirmed that the product was damaged before dispatch. A replacement has already been [2] and will leave our distribution center today. [3], you will not be charged for shipping or handling. [4]

Please reply to this message if you need further assistance.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team

questions.explanation: The phrase “the ___ this has caused” requires a noun. “Inconvenience” is the noun form.
The present perfect passive “has been ___” requires a past participle. “Ordered” also fits the replacement-order context.
Free shipping is a consequence of the company arranging the replacement. “As a result” shows that relationship.

options: Your replacement's tracking number will be sent to you as soon as the parcel is collected.
Our warehouse is closed every Sunday.
The damaged product was introduced last year.
Several other products are currently on sale.
questions.explanation: The tracking update logically follows the information that the replacement is being dispatched.

texts.title: Protective equipment requirement
texts.body:
NOTICE TO PRODUCTION STAFF
SUBJECT: Eye Protection in Workshop Area

Beginning Monday, all employees entering the workshop must wear [1] goggles. This requirement applies to visitors and temporary staff as well as permanent employees.

The equipment will be [2] by the company and may be collected from the supply desk before each shift. [3], supervisors will check that everyone follows this procedure. [4]

Thank you for helping us maintain a safe working environment.
Safety and Operations

questions.explanation: The blank comes before the noun “goggles,” so an adjective is required. “Protective goggles” is the correct phrase.
“Will be” is followed by a past participle to form the passive voice: “will be provided.”
The sentence introduces another measure that supports the safety requirement, so an additive transition is appropriate.

options: The workshop's new paint color was selected in April.
Daily inspections will be carried out to ensure that the goggles are worn correctly.
Staff may request a copy of last year's sales report.
The cafeteria will remain open during the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Daily inspections directly reinforce the requirement and the supervisors' role in checking compliance.

texts.title: New distribution center announced
texts.body:
Northgate Supplies Expands Regional Operations

Northgate Supplies has [1] a new distribution center outside the city, the company announced on Tuesday. The facility is expected to reduce delivery times for customers across the northern region.

The expansion represents a significant [2] in the company's logistics network. [3], the business expects to create approximately 80 new positions over the next year. [4]

Company representatives said that the center will begin processing orders in September.

questions.explanation: The announcement reports a completed event, so the simple past “opened” is appropriate.
The phrase “a significant ___” requires a singular noun. “Investment” describes the resources committed to the expansion.
The new facility is expected to create jobs as an outcome of the expansion. “As a result” makes this connection clear.

options: The additional roles will include drivers, warehouse coordinators and technical staff.
The company's first store opened more than 40 years ago.
Customers can currently buy stationery at a discount.
The city council meets on the second Wednesday of each month.
questions.explanation: The sentence develops the job-creation information by identifying the kinds of positions expected.

title: Services and procedures
description: Job offers, product announcements, recycling rules and conference information.

texts.title: Offer of employment
texts.body:
Redwood Advisory Group
Human Resources Department

Dear Ms. Patel,

We are pleased [1] you that you have been selected for the position of Client Services Coordinator. Your annual salary and benefits are outlined in the enclosed employment agreement.

Please review the document [2] and return the signed copy by August 12. [3], your start date is scheduled for September 2, subject to completion of the background check. [4]

We look forward to welcoming you to the team.

Sincerely,
Human Resources

questions.explanation: The formal expression is “pleased to inform you.” The adjective “pleased” is followed by an infinitive.
The blank modifies the verb “review,” so an adverb is needed. “Carefully” describes how the agreement should be reviewed.
The start-date information adds another important detail to the employment instructions.

options: Please contact our office if you have any questions about the terms of the offer.
The company previously operated from a smaller office.
Our annual report is available to investors.
The cafeteria serves lunch from noon until 2:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: A contact invitation logically concludes a formal offer letter and relates directly to the employment agreement.

texts.title: Introducing a new project platform
texts.body:
MAKE TEAM PROJECTS EASIER WITH PLANWISE

Planwise is a new online platform designed to help teams organize tasks and share updates. Its simple dashboard makes it [1] for users to see deadlines and responsibilities at a glance.

To get started, [2] the application from the company website and create a team profile. [3], invite colleagues who need access to your projects. [4]

A free introductory plan is available for organizations with up to five users. Visit Planwise online to learn more.

questions.explanation: The construction “makes it ___ for users to…” requires an adjective after “makes it.” “Easier” fits the meaning and grammar.
Software is obtained from a website by downloading it. The other verbs do not fit the instruction.
The passage lists steps for setting up the platform. “Next” introduces the following step.

options: The team can then assign tasks and monitor each project's progress in one place.
Planwise was founded in a coastal town.
The company cafeteria closes at 5:30 p.m.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains what users can do after inviting colleagues and completes the sequence of instructions.

texts.title: Recycling rules for office waste
texts.body:
TO: All Employees
FROM: Office Services
SUBJECT: Updated Recycling Procedures

To reduce waste, the company is introducing revised recycling procedures. Paper, cardboard and clean plastic containers should be placed in the [1] bins located near the elevators.

Food waste and liquids must be removed before containers are recycled. [2], confidential documents should be placed in the locked shredding boxes rather than in regular paper bins. [3] All departments are expected to follow the new procedure from October 1. [4]

Thank you for supporting this initiative.

questions.explanation: The blank describes the noun “bins,” so an adjective is required. “Appropriate bins” means the correct containers for each material.
The sentence gives a different handling rule for confidential paper, so “In contrast” signals a distinction.

options: A comma, joining it to the previous sentence
A full stop, because a new instruction begins
A question mark, because the sentence asks something
questions.explanation: The sentence is complete and the next sentence starts a new point about the effective date. A full stop is appropriate.

options: Managers will receive a short guide explaining where each type of waste should be placed.
The office building has six floors.
The company's logo was redesigned last year.
Employees may order additional stationery online.
questions.explanation: A guide for managers supports implementation of the new recycling procedure.

texts.title: Conference registration information
texts.body:
REGIONAL CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE CONFERENCE

Registration is now open for the annual Regional Customer Experience Conference, which will take place on November 14 at the Harbor Convention Center. This year's program includes expert talks and practical workshops for service professionals.

Participants are encouraged to register [1] the end of October to secure a place. The registration fee [2] access to all sessions and the networking reception. [3], attendees should indicate any dietary requirements on the online form. [4]

For the full program and registration details, visit the event website.

questions.explanation: “By the end of October” sets a deadline that must be met no later than that date.
The singular subject “fee” requires the singular verb “includes.”
Dietary requirements are another detail attendees need to provide when registering.

options: A confirmation e-mail will be sent after the registration has been completed.
The convention center opened its doors in 2004.
The event logo uses three shades of blue.
Several restaurants are located across the street.
questions.explanation: A confirmation message is a logical next step after the registration form and dietary information.

title: Customer information and company policy
description: Product recalls, technical support, budgets and airline updates.

texts.title: Voluntary product recall
texts.body:
SAFETY NOTICE: MODEL AX-20 DESK LAMP

Brightline Home is announcing a voluntary recall of its AX-20 desk lamp after identifying a possible electrical [1] in a limited number of units. Customers should stop using the product immediately.

The affected lamps were [2] between January and March and can be identified by the serial number printed on the base. [3], customers may return the lamp to any Brightline store for a full refund. [4]

We apologize for the concern this may cause and appreciate your attention to this matter.

questions.explanation: The phrase “an electrical ___” requires a noun. “Defect” refers to a fault in a product.
The subject “lamps” receives the action, and the sentence uses the passive form “were manufactured.”
The return and refund option follows from the recall announcement as a practical consequence.

options: No purchase receipt is required, but customers should bring the lamp and its power adapter.
The company plans to introduce a new garden range next spring.
Desk lamps are often used in home offices.
Brightline stores are closed on public holidays.
questions.explanation: The sentence supplies useful return instructions that directly support the refund information.

texts.title: Response to a login problem
texts.body:
TO: Mr. Adrian Cole
FROM: IT Help Desk
SUBJECT: Access to the Employee Portal

Thank you for reporting the difficulty you experienced when signing in to the employee portal. We have [1] your account and found that your password had expired.

Please use the password-reset link below and follow the instructions on the screen. Once the new password has been created, try to [2] to the portal again. [3], contact the Help Desk and include a screenshot of any error message that appears. [4]

questions.explanation: The support team has investigated the account, so “examined” fits the meaning.
“Log in” means to access an account by entering credentials.
The Help Desk should be contacted only in the condition that the problem continues after the password reset.

options: Our team will review the information and respond within one business day.
The portal was designed in the company's London office.
Employees may also use the portal to view cafeteria menus.
The next staff meeting is scheduled for Thursday.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes what the support team will do after the user sends the requested information.

texts.title: Department budget adjustment
texts.body:
TO: Department Managers
FROM: Finance Director
SUBJECT: Revised Operating Budgets

Following the quarterly review, the company has decided to adjust several department budgets. The changes are intended to ensure that available funds are [1] across current projects.

Managers should review the attached figures and submit any questions by Friday. [2], requests for additional funding must include a clear explanation of the expected business benefit. [3] The revised budget will take effect on the first day of next month. [4]

Finance will be available for individual consultations throughout the week.

questions.explanation: After “are,” a past participle forms the passive structure “are allocated.”
The funding explanation is an additional requirement, so an additive transition is needed.

questions.prompt: Which sentence best belongs in blank [3]?
options: All submissions must be approved by the relevant department director before they are sent to Finance.
The company picnic will be held in the spring.
Several departments recently changed their office furniture.
The annual report is available to the public.
questions.explanation: Director approval is directly relevant to requests for additional funding and the budget review process.

options: Managers should ensure that planned purchases are consistent with the new figures.
The Finance Director joined the company five years ago.
The building has recently added bicycle parking.
The company logo appears on all printed materials.
questions.explanation: This instruction explains what managers need to do when the revised budgets take effect.

texts.title: New routes for loyalty members
texts.body:
SKYWAY AIR: MEMBER NEWS

We are delighted to announce two new international routes from our central hub. Beginning December 5, direct flights to Lisbon and Madrid will operate six days a week. These new services will give members more [1] when planning business and leisure travel.

Members who book before November 10 will [2] double reward points on their first return trip. [3], early bookings will also receive priority seat selection at no additional cost. [4]

Thank you for continuing to travel with Skyway Air.

questions.explanation: The phrase “more ___ when planning” requires the noun “flexibility.”
After the modal verb “will,” use the base form “earn.”
Priority seat selection is another benefit, so “In addition” is appropriate.

options: Visit our website to view the updated timetable and book your flight.
Our first aircraft was purchased more than 30 years ago.
The airport has recently renovated its parking area.
Reward points can be used at selected restaurants.
questions.explanation: A call to action to view schedules and book naturally follows the announcement of new routes and member benefits.

title: Training and professional development
description: Workshop invitations, conference programs, performance reviews and shipping updates.

texts.title: Professional development workshop
texts.body:
TO: All Employees
FROM: Learning and Development Team
SUBJECT: Practical Presentation Skills Workshop

We are pleased to invite staff members to a half-day workshop on presentation skills. The session is designed to help employees communicate ideas more [1] and respond confidently to questions.

questions.explanation: The adverb “effectively” modifies the verb “communicate” and describes how ideas should be communicated.
Participants sign up for a workshop by registering.
The sentence adds another detail required on the form.

options: A confirmation message will be sent to successful applicants with the room details.
The company was established in the early 1980s.
The meeting room was painted last summer.
Some employees travel to work by train.
questions.explanation: A confirmation message is the logical next step after registration.

texts.title: Welcome to the annual industry summit
texts.body:
WELCOME TO THE GLOBAL OPERATIONS SUMMIT

On behalf of the organizing committee, welcome to this year's Global Operations Summit. Over the next two days, industry [1] will share practical ideas on supply chains, customer service and workplace technology.

We have prepared an [2] program of presentations and discussion sessions. [3], attendees are encouraged to join the networking reception at 5:30 p.m. on the first day. [4]

We hope you find the event informative and that you make valuable professional connections.

Conference Committee

questions.explanation: The plural noun “professionals” refers to the people attending the summit.
The blank describes the noun “program,” so an adjective is required.
The reception is highlighted as a specific activity that attendees are encouraged to join.

options: The complete session timetable appears on the following pages of this program.
The summit venue was built in 2008.
The city has several museums near the conference center.
The organizing committee meets every month.
questions.explanation: A reference to the timetable helps readers use the conference program and is relevant to the event information.

texts.title: Annual performance review process
texts.body:
TO: All Department Managers
FROM: Human Resources
SUBJECT: Annual Performance Reviews

As the fiscal year comes to a close, managers should begin preparing for the annual employee review process. Each manager is responsible for [1] the performance of every team member over the past twelve months.

Please arrange [2] meetings with employees to discuss achievements, development needs and goals for the coming year. [3], all completed review forms must reach Human Resources by March 20. [4]

Contact the HR team if you need clarification about the evaluation criteria.

questions.explanation: The structure “responsible for” is followed by a noun or gerund. “Evaluating” is the correct verb form.
The blank describes “meetings,” so the adjective “individual” is appropriate.
The deadline is an important instruction. “Please note” draws the reader's attention to it.

options: Managers who anticipate delays should inform HR before the submission deadline.
The HR office has recently changed its opening hours.
Employees may use the cafeteria during their lunch break.
The company has introduced a new logo.
questions.explanation: This sentence adds a relevant instruction concerning the review-form deadline.

texts.title: Shipment delay notification
texts.body:
TO: Ms. Rachel Kim
FROM: Meridian Freight Services
SUBJECT: Update on Shipment MF-29071

We are writing to inform you of an [1] delay affecting your shipment. Severe weather along the original route has required our driver to use an alternative highway.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. [2], the revised delivery date is now April 16 rather than April 14. [3] Our team will continue to monitor the shipment and provide updates if the estimated arrival time changes. [4]

Thank you for your patience.
Customer Logistics Team

questions.explanation: The noun “delay” is described by an adjective. “Unexpected delay” is the correct phrase.
The route change caused by severe weather leads to a later delivery date, so a result transition is needed.

questions.prompt: Which sentence best belongs in blank [3]?
options: You can check the latest status by entering your tracking number on our website.
Our company has operated for more than 25 years.
The shipment contains several different product categories.
Our drivers receive annual safety training.
questions.explanation: Tracking information is directly useful to the customer who has received a delivery-delay notice.

options: You will receive a further notification when the shipment leaves the regional distribution center.
Our offices are closed on public holidays.
The original delivery estimate was prepared last month.
We also provide packaging services for large orders.
questions.explanation: A follow-up notification describes the next communication the customer can expect about this delayed shipment.
